title: Write IPFS mock server for tests that don't need real IPFS
description:
Define a MockIpfsClient implementing the IPFS client trait (from the spike decision). The mock: stores blocks in a HashMap, simulates configurable failure modes (always fail, fail every Nth call, delay every call by Xms). All unit and integration tests that don't specifically test IPFS behavior use the mock. Artifact: core/src/ipfs/mock.rs (or test-only module).

Acceptance: mock implements the full IPFS client trait; failure injection configurable per test; no network I/O in mock; mock resets state between tests; all existing tests that use a real IPFS node are annotated with #[ignore] unless IPFS_TEST=1 set
